name: Expo React Native
rationale: Expo apps need native capability, environment, and screen/module boundaries so generated mobile code does not centralize navigation, state, permissions, and data access.

directories.purpose: Screen-level composition without owning all workflows.
Feature-owned mobile UI, hooks, and services.

fileRules.name: Expo No God Screens
fileRules.rule: Mobile screens should not own navigation, permissions, data access, state orchestration, and rendering in one file.
fileRules.trigger: A screen or UI file crosses the line threshold while owning multiple responsibilities.
fileRules.recommendation: Split native capability hooks, feature services, and presentational components.
fileRules.goodExample: ProfileScreen.tsx composes hooks and feature components while permissions live in src/features/profile/useProfilePermissions.ts.
fileRules.badExample: HomeScreen.tsx owns navigation, location permissions, fetching, mutations, and all rendering.

moduleBoundaries: Screens compose feature modules; feature modules own workflow logic.
Native capabilities should be isolated behind hooks or services.
testingExpectations: Add behavior tests for feature logic and document device/manual checks for native capability changes.
agentInstructions: Do not place full mobile workflows into a single screen file.
